Confirmed Observation: A provider can sign an on-chain predetermined response hash without demonstrating external HTTP delivery or computation; authenticated vote quorum can exclude the actual history if monitors are dishonest or measurements are unsound. Recommended Action / Acceptance: Formalize admissibility policy, evidence semantics, receipt meaning, and world-soundness proof obligations. Test counterexample where signed but undelivered service exists.

Confirmed Observation: Imports challenge, rpc_client, signed_probe, typed_evidence absent from this archive. Direct process invocation fails on challenge.

Confirmed Observation: Hard-coded chain ID 31337, known contract, known baseline lease, Anvil unlocked accounts and simulated time; all three probes run on localhost. This cannot establish independent multi-VM operation.

Confirmed Observation: Enrollment API is token-gated proposal/approval only; Ansible needs predeclared node IPs, SSH access and operator opt-in. Fresh Ubuntu auto-join is **not implemented**.

Confirmed Observation: Registry caps at 32 *ever* registered addresses; each snapshot loops through all candidates and locks pending selections. Not scalable, can exhaust future participation.
Recommended Action / Acceptance: Committed active-set snapshots, proof-based eligibility, gas-bounded pagination and churn tests.

Confirmed Observation: One privileged randomnessSource supplies an unverified seed after eligible set known; selection can be biased and censored.
Recommended Action / Acceptance: Proof-verified randomness or other verifiably unbiased protocol with bounded selection and recovery.

Confirmed Observation: All four selected monitors must confirm; no confirmation deadline or replacement path. One nonconfirming monitor blocks Ready permanently unless consumer closes the lease.
Recommended Action / Acceptance: Explicit acceptance deadline and permissionless reselection/cancellation; restore locked bonds and escrow.

Confirmed Observation: Consumer alone can close a lease; selected bonds are released only when lease state Closed. If consumer disappears, monitors lack unilateral release even when no further epochs can progress.
Recommended Action / Acceptance: Permissionless deadline-based lease closure and bond-release lifecycle independent from residual disputes, with strictly specified safety conditions.

Confirmed Observation: First settleEpoch call can earn a settlement bounty even when no guaranteed credits/exposure change, e.g. outcome None and no acknowledgment. This weakens the 'reward only productive transitions' rule.
Recommended Action / Acceptance: Define persisted first-settlement finalization as useful, or require a measurable state improvement and pay only on that condition. Test no-quorum/no-change case.

Confirmed Observation: Incentive escrow, residual EIP-712 agreement, and refund functions are present in source, unlike older reference; no verified Foundry execution in current environment.

Confirmed Observation: SLA policy is committed as a hash in marketplace path, but EVM evidence interpretation stays hard-coded N/F/S + 3-of-4; a direct lease can leave slaPolicyHash zero. Different service policies are not executable.

Confirmed Observation: Deterministic challenge and CPU digest can be produced without proving allocated CPU, continuous service or honest hardware.

Confirmed Observation: Local-only 127.0.0.1 restrictions are intentional safety guards; not a distributed monitoring or public-RPC implementation.
Recommended Action / Acceptance: Keep local adapters, add authenticated remote endpoint policy and configurable multi-RPC SDK; do not simply remove localhost checks.

Confirmed Observation: Signed ACK is accepted until evidence closure; signed response until monitoring closure. Neither cryptographically certifies external receipt/delivery time or challenge completion within the response deadline.
Recommended Action / Acceptance: Define stronger challenge-bound provider receipts and time/observer assumptions; retain N/F ambiguity when unsupported.

Confirmed Observation: Local evidence archive is just JSON files with hash commitments; no replication, authenticated retrieval, durable retention, or independently verifiable monitor-clock claims.

Confirmed Observation: Current dashboard is local administrative inventory/proposal interface, not chain event indexer, ETH financial ledger, monitoring telemetry platform or global observatory.

Confirmed Observation: CI runs Python/Foundry unit jobs but has no signed GHCR artifact build, release manifests, VM pull updates, rollout or rollback.
